selection: Second frozen index in each of three datasets in original30 and added60. No outcomes used to select these six. Score separately; not a blind holdout.
rule: Preserve all original capped IBS selections and the visible span. Revisit at most four clean prefix rows only in warm unused seats. Project rows, update self-conditioning, do not sample extra rows.
gate: All 12 same-device plain/off replays must agree on complete outputs, selected rows, admissions, EOS/length, post-prefill encoder inputs, N/F/Q and score. On arm must pass the physical-row and first-fork audit. This qualifies the runner, not a gain on 90 tasks.
